title: Linx Eden Switch Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
THE LINX EDEN SWITCH

The Eden Switch dry herb vape by Linx Vapor, is a true convection vaporizer that decarbs your herb so it never burns.

Simple to use, easy to clean, and conserves your herb. Savor the flavor and experience a new form of vaping.

Removable quartz dosing capsule, up to 8 hits per Capsule
True convection heating
4-Mode adjustable temperatures, with heat boost mode

Removable Dosing Capsule

Made of premium quality quartz, the large dosing capsule acts as a removable chamber. Simply fill the capsule with your favorite flower, drop it in the Eden Switch, and you are ready to go.

– Up to 8 hits per Capsule.
– Easy cleaning.
– Low key loading.
– Toxins free.
– Carry a variety of strains with Dosing Capsule Set (sold separately).
– Extend the lifespan of the heating chamber.

Taste the Terpenes

With true convection heating, the Linx Eden Switch always heats your flower evenly to the perfect temperature. This means every hit is full of complex terpene profiles and the full spectrum of cannabinoids.

INCLUDED IN THE KIT:
1 Linx Eden Switch Device
1 Removable Quartz Dosing Capsule
1 Magnetic Mouthpiece Cap
3 Silicone Mouthpiece Caps
3 Glass Mouthpieces
4 Filter Screens
1 Silicone Sleeve
1 Dosing Capsule Seal
1 USB-C Charging Cable
1 Metal Tool
1 Cleaning Brush
1 User Manual

FEATURES:
– Air Insulation
– Toxin Free Materials
– Glass Mouthpiece
– Stainless Steel Shell
– True Convection Heating
– Removeable Quartz Dosing Capsule
– 4 Temperatures + Heat Boost
– Stealth Mode
– Interchangeable silicone sleeve
– Dimension: 5 inch (height) x 1 inch (diameter)
– Weight: 4.4 oz (125g)
